# DESIGN:OS

> FREE design tools for AI coding agents by Jang Trịnh. All products are free and source-available under PolyForm Shield 1.0.0.

## Products

- [DESIGN:OS Studio](https://jangtrinh.github.io/design-os-studio/): Native GPU-accelerated interface design studio built in Rust, with an MCP server and Dev Mode code output. Reads and writes .fig files. Repo: https://github.com/jangtrinh/design-os-studio
- [DESIGN:OS CLI](https://jangtrinh.github.io/design-os/): Design CLI for Claude Code, Codex and Antigravity: describe the UI in plain words and get production-grade web, SwiftUI and Figma-compatible output, checked by deterministic gates. Repo: https://github.com/jangtrinh/design-os
- [DESIGN:OS Bridge](https://jangtrinh.github.io/design-os-figma-plugin/): Plugin and CLI that lets Claude Code, Codex or any shell agent read and edit the design file you have open. Works with Figma, including the Free plan. Local WebSocket, one undo step per change, no seat. Repo: https://github.com/jangtrinh/design-os-figma-plugin
- [mcp-bridge-go](https://github.com/jangtrinh/mcp-bridge-go): Go MCP server (stdio) that sends a prompt to an Electron-based AI IDE on macOS (Antigravity, Cursor, Windsurf) and returns the workspace git diff. Repo: https://github.com/jangtrinh/mcp-bridge-go
- [DESIGN:OS SVG Animation](https://jangtrinh.github.io/design-os-svg-animation/): Deterministic vector animation and 1080p 60fps video pipeline for AI coding agents, with a Motion IR compiler and verification gates. Repo: https://github.com/jangtrinh/design-os-svg-animation
- [DESIGN:OS Code2Flow](https://jangtrinh.github.io/design-os-code2flow/): Local CLI that turns a Next.js, React Router, Expo, SwiftUI, Flutter or Compose codebase into user-flow maps and a UX gap report. Repo: https://github.com/jangtrinh/design-os-code2flow
- [DESIGN:OS 3D Blender](https://jangtrinh.github.io/design-os-3d-blender/): AI agent system for Blender 5.2: agent skills, verified bpy knowledge base, execution contract and a production gate for 3D-printable parts. On the official MCP Registry. Repo: https://github.com/jangtrinh/design-os-3d-blender

## Ecosystem

FREE and source-available under PolyForm Shield 1.0.0.

- [DESIGN:OS Vietnamese](https://jangtrinh.github.io/design-os-vietnamese/): Free, offline Vietnamese copy linter plus 16 agent skills for Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI and Antigravity. Zero telemetry. Repo: https://github.com/jangtrinh/design-os-vietnamese
- [DESIGN:OS Skills](https://github.com/jangtrinh/design-os-skills-pack): 32 free agent skills from the suite, in one folder you can copy into Claude Code, Codex or Cursor. Repo: https://github.com/jangtrinh/design-os-skills-pack
- [DESIGN:OS Knowledge Builder](https://jangtrinh.github.io/design-os-knowledge-builder/): Ontology-first knowledge packs: claims with verifiable sources, and a ledger-backed stopping gate for coding agents. Repo: https://github.com/jangtrinh/design-os-knowledge-builder
- [DESIGN:OS Agent Teacher](https://jangtrinh.github.io/design-os-pedagogy/): Evidence-graded pedagogy library and a local teacher rehearsal on authored fraction cases. Python, no model calls. Repo: https://github.com/jangtrinh/design-os-pedagogy
- [DESIGN:OS Voice UX](https://jangtrinh.github.io/design-os-voice-ux/): Handbook, barge-in state machines, latency budgets and an audit rubric for real-time voice agents. Repo: https://github.com/jangtrinh/design-os-voice-ux
- [DESIGN:OS Generative UI](https://jangtrinh.github.io/design-os-generative-ui/): Stream-first visual runtime for agents: 60fps DOM reconciliation, a streaming HTML sanitizer and a WebGL/Canvas widget bridge. Repo: https://github.com/jangtrinh/design-os-generative-ui
- [DESIGN:OS System One](https://jangtrinh.github.io/design-os-system-one/): Sub-10ms calibrated judgments for agents, on-device on Apple Silicon, with a cloud triage fallback. Repo: https://github.com/jangtrinh/design-os-system-one
- [DESIGN:OS Apple](https://jangtrinh.github.io/design-os-apple/): Native Swift 6.2 and SwiftUI component system with an adaptive color engine for iOS 26, iPadOS 26 and macOS 26. Repo: https://github.com/jangtrinh/design-os-apple
- [DESIGN:OS GitHub Pages](https://jangtrinh.github.io/design-os-github-page/): Zero-dependency GitHub Pages scaffolder with a 10-gate SEO, AEO and GEO check for repos and developer profiles. Repo: https://github.com/jangtrinh/design-os-github-page
- [DESIGN:OS Origami](https://jangtrinh.github.io/design-os-origami/): Parametric packaging dielines, foldability checks, spot-color print PDFs and DXFs, and 3D fold previews. Python stdlib only. Repo: https://github.com/jangtrinh/design-os-origami
- [mcpop](https://github.com/jangtrinh/mcpop): Observability proxy and silent-failure catcher for MCP servers: flags retry loops, schema mismatches and slow tool calls. One Go binary with a local dashboard. Repo: https://github.com/jangtrinh/mcpop
- [multi-AI-profile](https://jangtrinh.github.io/multi-AI-profile/): Run several isolated Claude, Antigravity, Codex, Grok, Cursor and Windsurf accounts on macOS, with separate MCP and CLI configs. Instant APFS clones, zero telemetry. Repo: https://github.com/jangtrinh/multi-AI-profile
- [Orchestration System by Jang](https://github.com/jangtrinh/orchestration-system-by-jang): A portable system for delegating work to AI agents without losing control: dispatch contracts, capability routing and independent verification. Works on any agent runtime. Repo: https://github.com/jangtrinh/orchestration-system-by-jang
- [Ổi Browser](https://jangtrinh.github.io/oi-browser/): A local-first AI browser (v1.0.0) with nine domain companions and Markdown memory. Runs on your installed AI CLIs, with zero cloud telemetry. Repo: https://github.com/jangtrinh/oi-browser
- [OPAH ONE](https://jangtrinh.github.io/design-os-drone-showcase/): Scroll-scrubbed product page with 343 WebP frames and an exploded-view tour. Fictional product, real pipeline. Repo: https://github.com/jangtrinh/design-os-drone-showcase
- [Contour House](https://jangtrinh.github.io/design-os-rill-architecture/): Service page for a fictional architecture studio, with GSAP parallax. Fictional brand, real pipeline. Repo: https://github.com/jangtrinh/design-os-rill-architecture
- [Robotic Arm](https://design-os-animejs.vercel.app): A 3D scrollytelling showcase in the anime.js style, driven by one scroll value. Repo: https://github.com/jangtrinh/design-os-animejs
- [AURA](https://github.com/jangtrinh/aura-scrollcinema-demo): Scroll-scrubbed cinematic product page with a 2K exploded-view film generated by DESIGN:OS. Repo: https://github.com/jangtrinh/aura-scrollcinema-demo
